text: A mail ballot postmarked on Election Day counts in California if it arrives within 7 days.

room.label: 5C students
room.note: HUMAN: campus set — fill from the 5C survey; confirm answer against truthSource.

truthSource.label: California Elections Code §3020
truthSource.oneLine: A vote-by-mail ballot postmarked on or before Election Day counts if the elections official receives it no later than seven days after the election.
